tasks.label: Ouro: Run Browser Test Harness (Chrome)
tasks.command: osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome"' -e 'activate' -e 'set matchingTabs to (tabs of windows whose URL contains "ouro_test.html")' -e 'set found to false' -e 'repeat with winTabs in matchingTabs' -e 'repeat with t in winTabs' -e 'reload t' -e 'set found to true' -e 'end repeat' -e 'end repeat' -e 'end tell' -e 'if not found then do shell script "open -na \"Google Chrome\" --args --profile-directory=\"Profile 7\" \"file://${workspaceFolder}/tests/ouro_test.html\""'
